judgment.notes: A001-A005 use the stated horizon, regularities and real mean-zero data on the same normalized torus. The initial homogeneous norm bounds follow from D003-D004 and reflection. E002 is used only at theta=0 with the actual norm-sum bound 2R. B_t is used on smooth inputs, so no unavailable L^2 extension estimate is needed.

S002 correctly computes u_t+u_xxx=-UU_x=u u_x. Reflection, homogeneous/inhomogeneous norm comparison and the supplied uniform source bound give A(T,gamma,R). BG001-BG002 justify physical-path continuity, distributional conversion and the source uniqueness-class identification. A002 plus agreement of source flows gives smoothness (BG004). A004-A005 and A003 give the full L^2 pairwise statement; isometry gives the twisted bounds and smooth differentiation gives v'=B_t(v,v)/2. All clauses of N001 follow, including M<=1+A.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
